06_frontlit_hiding_distance.title: More filament thickness hides more of the base
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.description: Three schematic stacks have progressively more orange layers over a dark base. Their visible swatches approach the opaque filament color as thickness increases. Frontlit light enters and returns after reflection underneath. Colors are illustrative, not predictions for a particular spool.
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.moreThicknessHidesMoreOfTheBase: More thickness hides more of the base
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.frontlitViewingLightEntersTheSurfaceRefl: Frontlit viewing: light enters the surface, reflects underneath, and returns.
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.atThicknessHD10RemainsInThisModel: At thickness = HD, 10% remains in this model. Visual opacity needs a comparison.
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.higherHDMoreThicknessToHideTheSame: Higher HD → more thickness to hide the same base. Backlit TD is a different input scale.
06_frontlit_hiding_distance.schematicColorsAndLayersNotMeasurements: Schematic colors and layers, not measurements

07_calibration_wedge.title: Read the first wedge patch that matches the reference rail
07_calibration_wedge.description: An illustrative eight-patch wedge has a tab at its one-layer end and an opaque rail beside all patches. Patch six is the first shown matching the rail. Max layers sets the last patch; layer height sets each thickness increment. A side view shows increasing thickness over a common base. The optional Merge read compares neighboring patches rather than the reference rail.
07_calibration_wedge.matchComparesAPatchWithTheRailBeside: Match compares a patch with the rail beside it
07_calibration_wedge.exampleOnly8PatchesPrintedTheFirstRail: Example only: 8 patches printed; the first rail match is patch 6.
07_calibration_wedge.opaqueReferenceRailMadeFromTheFilamentBe: Opaque reference rail, made from the filament being measured
07_calibration_wedge.sideViewOneMoreLayerPerStep: Side view: one more layer per step
07_calibration_wedge.baseBelowLayerHeightSetsEachRise: Base below; layer height sets each rise.
07_calibration_wedge.enterTheLastPatchStillDifferent: Enter the last patch still different
07_calibration_wedge.fromThePatchImmediatelyBeforeIt: from the patch immediately before it.
07_calibration_wedge.itChecksTheCurveNotTheRailMatch: It checks the curve, not the rail match.
07_calibration_wedge.illustrativeReadsColorsAndExaggeratedHei: Illustrative reads, colors, and exaggerated heights

08_opacity_solve.title: A wedge read locates the visible opacity threshold
08_opacity_solve.description: A schematic curve of patch-to-rail color difference falls as filament layers increase. The example first matching patch is six, where the difference reaches a just-noticeable threshold. Patch count times layer height gives thickness; the model combines thickness with filament and base colors to infer hiding distance. The graph is explanatory, not measured data.
08_opacity_solve.yourReadLocatesAVisibleThreshold: Your read locates a visible threshold
08_opacity_solve.theDifferenceFromTheOpaqueRailFallsAs: The difference from the opaque rail falls as filament thickness increases.
08_opacity_solve.theDefaultJNDIsAbout2E00More: The default JND is about 2 ΔE00. More informative base reads can refine the model.
08_opacity_solve.schematicCurveAndExampleReadNotMeasureme: Schematic curve and example read, not measurement data

09_palette_proof.title: Palette Proof candidates are stopping heights on one stack
09_palette_proof.description: An illustrative proof map has two target rows and three candidates A through C. An F-marked candidate is the shared foundation margin, not an extra printed color. A side view of one target's candidates shows the same material order, with each candidate stopping at a different layer prefix. Horizontal layers use the same filament wherever they continue. Colors and heights are schematic.
09_palette_proof.candidatesStopAtDifferentHeightsOfTheSam: Candidates stop at different heights of the same stack
09_palette_proof.aPrefixIncludesTheFoundationAndEveryPrec: A prefix includes the foundation and every preceding layer, in physical print order.
09_palette_proof.sideViewOfOneCandidateRow: Side view of one candidate row
09_palette_proof.laterPrefixesKeepEveryLayerBelow: Later prefixes keep every layer below.
09_palette_proof.touchingPatchesShareAContinuousFoundatio: Touching patches share a continuous foundation. Targets are not additional printed colors.
09_palette_proof.schematicLayoutLayersAndAppearanceNotToS: Schematic layout, layers, and appearance; not to scale

10_physical_size.title: Three different kinds of detail
10_physical_size.description: Same four-pixel grid at two physical scales, compared with twice as many pixels at the original scale.
10_physical_size.schematicZoomANozzleSExtrusionWidthRemai: Schematic zoom. A nozzle's extrusion width remains a separate physical limit.

11_manual_layers.title: A row is a thickness, not a top height
11_manual_layers.description: Three columns stop at the black, red, and white surfaces; their heights add upward from a common plate.
11_manual_layers.aRowIsAThicknessNotATop: A row is a thickness, not a top height
11_manual_layers.schematicIncreasingALowerRunLiftsLaterSu: Schematic. Increasing a lower run lifts later surfaces and moves later swaps.

12_smooth_boundaries.title: Smooth contours, same source detail
12_smooth_boundaries.description: A stair-stepped diagonal becomes a connected smoother boundary. Pixel size and layer height do not change.
12_smooth_boundaries.schematicOutlineOnlyBothChoicesAlterExpo: Schematic outline only. Both choices alter exported contours; neither adds source pixels.

13_printable_detail.title: Width warnings preserve lines; optional cleanup only omits isolated color specks
13_printable_detail.description: At 0.10 mm per pixel, a two-pixel purple stripe is 0.20 mm wide, narrower than the planned 0.40 mm extrusion width. The preview marks it amber as a warning, not as a new filament color. The stripe is kept whether Omit isolated color specks is off or on. With cleanup on, only a tiny enclosed pink speck is replaced by its surrounding wider blue region. Pink is used nowhere else in this example. These are input colors, not guaranteed print colors. The original 2D image is unchanged.
13_printable_detail.aWidthWarningDoesNotEraseDetail: A width warning does not erase detail
13_printable_detail.examplePixelSize010MmPixelStripe: Example: Pixel Size = 0.10 mm/pixel. Stripe = 2 pixels = 0.20 mm.
13_printable_detail.thePlannedLineIsTwiceAsWideAs: The planned line is twice as wide as the stripe.
13_printable_detail.aSourceColorCheckNotALayerSimulation: A source-color check, not a layer simulation.
13_printable_detail.belowInputToAutoPaintNotAPrediction: Below: input to Auto-paint, not a prediction of the finished print.
13_printable_detail.oNKeepLinesOmitOnlySpecks: ON: keep lines; omit only specks
13_printable_detail.pinkOccursOnlyInThisTinyEnclosedSpeck: Pink occurs only in this tiny enclosed speck. Colors also used in lines or wide regions stay.
13_printable_detail.your2DImageStaysUnchangedSourceColorWidt: Your 2D image stays unchanged. Source-color widths cannot guarantee printability.

14_repeats_separation.title: Repeats and separation solve different problems
14_repeats_separation.description: A repeated material expands possible stack sequences. Separation assigns distinct outputs; partial mode can merge an unmatched target.
14_repeats_separation.repeatsAndSeparationSolveDifferentProble: Repeats and separation solve different problems
14_repeats_separation.conceptualExamplesStrictModeRejectsAnInc: Conceptual examples. Strict mode rejects an incomplete distinct-color assignment.

15_transition_height.title: A height cap squeezes transitions, not the foundation
15_transition_height.description: The foundation stays opaque while upper runs are compressed to fit a lower printable cap.
15_transition_height.aHeightCapSqueezesTransitionsNotTheFound: A height cap squeezes transitions, not the foundation
15_transition_height.schematicAnImpossiblyLowCapFailsInsteadO: Schematic. An impossibly low cap fails instead of shrinking the opaque foundation.

16_height_dithering.title: When fractional heights are present
16_height_dithering.description: Conditional mechanism: fractional-height rounding error can be distributed among neighboring low and high printable heights. Already-discrete input regions may remain unchanged.
16_height_dithering.fractionalHeightRoundsToOneLayer: Fractional height rounds to one layer.
16_height_dithering.possibleIntermediateToneAtADistance: Possible intermediate tone at a distance.
16_height_dithering.schematicMechanismOnlyAlreadySnappedRegi: Schematic mechanism only. Already-snapped regions may remain unchanged.

17_flat_paint_orientation.title: Same artwork, three physical arrangements
17_flat_paint_orientation.description: Each three-column cross-section uses black foundation, orange middle, and yellow upper materials. Face-down reverses columns and adds a carrier; face-up raises shorter columns.
17_flat_paint_orientation.schematicCrossSectionsFlatPaintNeedsMult: Schematic cross-sections. Flat Paint needs multi-material 3MF; never mirror it again.

18_optimizer_choices.title: Choose where the optimizer spends its effort
18_optimizer_choices.description: The same image is weighted equally, toward its center, or toward edges. Separate transition-detail examples show increasing potential height choices, not exact layer counts.
18_optimizer_choices.transitionDetailMorePotentialThicknessCh: Transition detail: more potential thickness choices
18_optimizer_choices.fastBalancedThoroughDeepMoreSearchWorkNo: Fast → Balanced → Thorough → Deep: more search work, not guaranteed print accuracy.
18_optimizer_choices.schematicWeightingAndChoicesEarlyConverg: Schematic weighting and choices. Early convergence and Max Height can limit transitions.

19_preview_only.title: Inspecting a range does not crop the print
19_preview_only.description: Lower and upper layers are hidden in the preview but all four layers remain in the export.
19_preview_only.inspectingARangeDoesNotCropThePrint: Inspecting a range does not crop the print
19_preview_only.schematicCameraShadingWireframeAndPrevie: Schematic. Camera, shading, wireframe, and preview colors are inspection-only too.

20_calibration_choices.title: Choose the calibration evidence you need
20_calibration_choices.description: A wedge measures one filament's opacity. A Palette Proof compares artwork targets with printed candidates. A Stack Matrix photographs many known recipes. All inform predicted colors and stack choices, not printer extrusion settings. Drawings are schematic, not measured color predictions.
20_calibration_choices.combineEvidenceWhereItHelpsNoneOfThese: Combine evidence where it helps. None of these tunes the printer.
20_calibration_choices.readAPatchBesideItsRail: Read a patch beside its rail.
20_calibration_choices.predictedColorsStackChoiceHeightsAndSwap: Predicted colors → stack choice → heights and swap plan

21_proof_rounds.title: How Palette Proof judgments guide another round
21_proof_rounds.description: Best available supports a winner without claiming a color match. Close adds a soft correction and Dead on adds a strong anchor. Continue targets keeps winners and explores challengers. None supplies no winner and leads to untried alternatives. New targets gathers evidence about another part of the image. Example colors are schematic.
21_proof_rounds.aProofIsAComparisonNotAPass: A proof is a comparison, not a pass/fail test
21_proof_rounds.judgeThePhysicalPatchesFirstThenChooseWh: Judge the physical patches first. Then choose what to test next.
21_proof_rounds.noWinnerAndNoInventedCorrectColor: No winner and no invented correct color.
21_proof_rounds.testDifferentArtworkColorsFewerUsefulCan: Test different artwork colors. Fewer useful candidates can mean a smaller next coupon.
21_proof_rounds.schematicComparisonNotAPredictedPrintRes: Schematic comparison, not a predicted print result

22_matrix_alignment.title: Place Stack Matrix handles at marker centers
22_matrix_alignment.description: A six-by-six schematic board has a four-by-four recipe grid surrounded by a one-cell border. Markers 1, 2, 3, and 4 sit in the corner border cells. Handles belong in the centers of those cells, half a cell from the physical outside edge. The enlarged corner highlights the wrong outside corner and the correct marker center. Review every projected line before confirming alignment.
22_matrix_alignment.theHandleIsACellCenterNotThe: The handle is a cell center, not the board corner
22_matrix_alignment.useThisRecordSPrintedCornerKeyMarker: Use this record's printed corner key. Marker colors vary between boards.
22_matrix_alignment.outerEdgeSitsHalfACellBeyondThe: Outer edge sits half a cell beyond the center.
22_matrix_alignment.reviewTheWholeGridNotJustTheCorners: Review the whole grid, not just the corners.
22_matrix_alignment.thenConfirmAdjustedLowConfidenceAlignmen: Then confirm adjusted / low-confidence alignment before saving the sampled colors.
22_matrix_alignment.schematicBoardWithAnIllustrative44Recipe: Schematic board with an illustrative 4 × 4 recipe grid

23_calibration_scope.title: A measured layer recipe belongs to its physical thickness
23_calibration_scope.description: Three 0.08 millimeter layers make 0.24 millimeters of color material. Three 0.04 millimeter layers make 0.12 millimeters. A matrix measurement of the first is not reused as the second. Wedge hiding distance can still estimate behavior by thickness, while exact appearance evidence needs compatible layers, filaments, and backing. Layer thicknesses are schematic and colors are not measurements.
23_calibration_scope.sameLayerCountDoesNotMeanTheSame: Same layer count does not mean the same color recipe
23_calibration_scope.aFinerLayerGridChangesTheMaterialThickne: A finer layer grid changes the material thickness represented by each step.
23_calibration_scope.hDCanStillEstimateByThickness: HD can still estimate by thickness
23_calibration_scope.thatDoesNotCertifyTheNewSetup: That does not certify the new setup.
23_calibration_scope.matchRegularLayerHeightAndProfile: Match regular layer height and profile.
23_calibration_scope.schematicThicknessesAndMaterialColorsNot: Schematic thicknesses and material colors, not optical predictions

30_crop_resize_scale.title: Pixels, framing, and physical size
30_crop_resize_scale.description: Three schematic examples distinguish cropping a region, resampling to fewer pixels, and changing millimeters per pixel.
30_crop_resize_scale.startingExample1000800OpaquePixelsAt0: Starting example: 1000 × 800 opaque pixels at 0.1 mm/px = 100 × 80 mm
30_crop_resize_scale.zoomChangesNoneOfTheseItOnlyChanges: Zoom changes none of these. It only changes your view.
30_crop_resize_scale.transparentOuterMarginsAreExcludedFromTh: Transparent outer margins are excluded from the printed footprint. Schematic, not to scale.

31_pixel_tools.title: Small pixel edits become physical features
31_pixel_tools.description: Brush paints opaque pixels, eraser creates transparent holes, fill changes an edge-connected region, and text is rasterized without antialiasing.
31_pixel_tools.smallPixelEditsBecomePhysicalFeatures: Small pixel edits become physical features
31_pixel_tools.exactColorsHardEdgesAndImagePixelSizes: Exact colors, hard edges, and image-pixel sizes
31_pixel_tools.at01MmPxAOnePixel: At 0.1 mm/px, a one-pixel stroke is only 0.1 mm wide.
31_pixel_tools.pickerSamplesASourceColorCustomColorsMay: Picker samples a source color; custom colors may add targets. Enlarging the view adds no detail.

32_adjustment_controls.title: Twelve controls for the target image
32_adjustment_controls.description: Each control has schematic negative, zero, and positive color samples. Tone controls affect different brightness ranges, color controls shift hue or saturation, and clarity affects local edges.
32_adjustment_controls.twelveControlsForTheTargetImage: Twelve controls for the target image
32_adjustment_controls.eachRowOfSwatchesNegativeZeroPositiveDir: Each row of swatches: negative / zero / positive. Directional examples, not measured output.
32_adjustment_controls.toneRangeOverlapAndOtherActiveSlidersAff: Tone-range overlap and other active sliders affect the result. Alpha is unchanged.

33_adjustment_bake.title: Preview first, then bake the image
33_adjustment_bake.description: Adjustments create a non-destructive preview. Apply writes adjusted pixels into the working image and resets sliders. Downstream quantization, image download, and 3D use the working image.
33_adjustment_bake.previewFirstThenBakeTheImage: Preview first, then bake the image
33_adjustment_bake.aVisibleAdjustmentIsNotYetAChange: A visible adjustment is not yet a change to the source pixels.
33_adjustment_bake.withoutApplyTheseStepsStillUseTheUnderly: Without Apply, these steps still use the underlying image, not the live preview.

34_quantization_pipeline.title: Two limits, two different jobs
34_quantization_pipeline.description: Algorithm Weight sets an intermediate palette budget. Auto's Number of Colors limits the final result, or a fixed palette provides the permitted final colors. None skips the first stage only.
34_quantization_pipeline.exampleWeight128AutoTarget16TheResult: Example: Weight 128 → Auto target 16. The result may contain fewer colors.
34_quantization_pipeline.applyChangesTheImageUndoBeforeTestingAno: Apply changes the image. Undo before testing another setting from the same source.
34_quantization_pipeline.transparentPixelsStayTransparentPartiall: Transparent pixels stay transparent; partially transparent pixels become opaque.

35_swatch_operations.title: Recolor, remove, or remap?
35_swatch_operations.description: Three schematic images compare applying a new color, applying zero alpha, and deleting a swatch. Delete maps to the remaining palette rather than making transparent holes.
35_swatch_operations.startingImageAmberBackgroundAndTwoDiscon: Starting image: amber background and two disconnected pink regions.
35_swatch_operations.deleteRerunsTheSelectedQuantizerSoOtherI: Delete reruns the selected quantizer, so other image colors may change as well.
35_swatch_operations.chooseNoneForDirectRemappingUseEraserOr: Choose None for direct remapping; use Eraser or alpha = 0 to remove a background.

36_dedither_neighbors.title: Neighbor support, not a blur radius
36_dedither_neighbors.description: In the example the pink center has three same-color neighbors and five cyan alternatives. It remains pink at Weight 3 and becomes cyan at Weight 4. More passes repeat cleanup, potentially removing thin features.
36_dedither_neighbors.neighborSupportNotABlurRadius: Neighbor support, not a blur radius
36_dedither_neighbors.aPixelChecksEightNeighborsIncludingDiago: A pixel checks eight neighbors, including diagonals. Exact RGB and alpha must match.
36_dedither_neighbors.pass1NewImagePass2NewImage: Pass 1 → new image → Pass 2 → new image. More passes can erase small features.

40_build_export_snapshot.title: Build captures the model you will export
40_build_export_snapshot.description: Changed print settings need another build. Viewing only part of a built stack does not crop the export.
40_build_export_snapshot.buildCapturesTheModelYouWillExport: Build captures the model you will export
40_build_export_snapshot.cameraShadingAndSimulatedPhysicalColorsO: Camera, shading and Simulated / Physical colors only change the view.
40_build_export_snapshot.schematicLayersNotACalibratedColorPredic: Schematic layers, not a calibrated color prediction.

41_swap_layers.title: A swap layer is the first layer of the next filament
41_swap_layers.description: A stack with a 0.10 millimeter first layer and 0.04 millimeter regular layers switches to yellow before layer four. Layer tops and the material-change boundary have different Z heights.
41_swap_layers.aSwapLayerIsTheFirstLayerOf: A swap layer is the first layer of the next filament
41_swap_layers.bothHeightsDescribeTheSameSwap: Both heights describe the same swap.
41_swap_layers.checkWhereYourSlicerInsertsTheChangeDo: Check where your slicer inserts the change. Do not scale the model in Z.
41_swap_layers.illustrativeStackYourActualInstructionsC: Illustrative stack. Your actual instructions come from the built model.
